relations.text: SpaceXは2025年12月31日時点で、Teslaから506百万ドルのMegapack製品と131百万ドルのCybertruckを購入した
relations.text_en: As of December 31, 2025, SpaceX purchased $506 million of Megapack products and $131 million of Cybertrucks from Tesla

source.label: SpaceX June 30 2026 Form 10-Q; segments / related-party purchases / acquisitions
source.label_en: SpaceX June 30 2026 Form 10-Q; segments / related-party purchases / acquisitions
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, the Company purchased $ 506 million of Megapack products and $ 131 million of Cybertrucks at manufacturer’s suggested retail price from Tesla, recorded in Property, plant, and equipment, net in the consolidated balance sheets.

relations.text: 2026年6月30日までの3か月と6か月で、SpaceXはTeslaからMegapack製品をそれぞれ295百万ドル、329百万ドル購入した

source.label: SpaceX June 30 2026 Form 10-Q; segments / related-party purchases / acquisitions
source.label_en: SpaceX June 30 2026 Form 10-Q; segments / related-party purchases / acquisitions
source.quote: During the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, the Company purchased $ 295 million and $ 329 million, respectively, of Megapack products from Tesla, Inc.

relations.text: 2025年11月5日に契約を改定して再締結し、最大15MHz分のAWS-3周波数ライセンスを追加した
relations.text_en: On November 5, 2025 the parties amended and restated the agreement to include licenses for up to 15 MHz of additional unpaired AWS-3 spectrum

source.label: SpaceX June 30 2026 Form 10-Q; segments / related-party purchases / acquisitions

source.quote: On November 5, 2025, the parties amended and restated the Spectrum License Purchase Agreement to include EchoStar’s licenses for up to 15 MHz of additional unpaired AWS-3 spectrum (together with the AWS-4 and H-Block Licenses, the “Spectrum Licenses”).

source.quote: space launch facilities and related infrastructure, an increase in purchases of marketable securities of $13,029 million from cash proceeds received from the IPO and the SpaceX Notes, and an increase in payments to EchoStar for the Spectrum Licenses of $856 million.

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from existing and new companies including SpaceX’s Starlink, which is developing satellite communications technology using LEO constellations to provide competitive services in the direct-to-device segment of the mobile satellite services industry.

source.label: IREN 10-K
source.quote: As a global AI Cloud Services provider, we compete with hyperscalers, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud, as well as specialized AI Cloud Services providers, including CoreWeave, Nebius, Crusoe, Lambda, Nscale, SpaceX and others.

relations.text: SpaceXが直接競合に乗り出せば、Planet Labsより高度で安価な製品を出せる可能性がある
relations.text_en: If SpaceX decided to compete directly with Planet Labs, it could offer more advanced or lower priced products.

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: For example, SpaceX’s vertical integration and use of its own launch vehicles provides cost and speed advantages that could enable it to offer more advanced or lower priced offerings, if they were to decide to compete with us directly.
source.note: 参入の可能性としての記載です。
source.note_en: Describes a potential entry into competition.
